gotchas: Guest checkout, no login needed. Flow: homepage Search flights -> results (Economy fare card -> Saver/Flex/Flex Plus 'Select') -> Review your flights 'Continue to Passengers' -> passenger details 'Continue to Options' -> Options (seats/bags/insurance all optional) 'Continue to Payment' -> Make a purchase.

Homepage search form: accept the OneTrust banner first (#onetrust-accept-btn-handler), its dark filter intercepts every click. Departure/Arrival are input[name="Departure Airport"] / input[name="Arrival Airport"] (3 matches each, use the first): type the IATA code (DXB, MCT) and press Enter to take the first suggestion. Tick 'One-way' in the date panel, click the day button (e.g. 'Friday, 23 October 2026'), then 'Search flights'.
The booking is handed to the country site of the origin (e.g. 'You will be taken to the United Arab Emirates site'), so prices show in that currency (AED).

Custom dropdowns (passenger Title #title, card expiry #select_0 / #select_1) ignore clicks on the button (click times out); focus and press ArrowDown to open, then click the role=option. Expiry options are labelled like 'Aug Month' and '2030 Year'.

Contact phone country code defaults to the egress country (#country-code); a phone number that does not fit that country's format makes 'Continue to Options' fail with a generic 'Sorry, we were unable to process your request due to a technical error' banner rather than a field error.

Payment: choose 'Credit/Debit card' to expand the inline card form (no iframe): #input_0 card number, #input_1 name on card, expiry dropdowns. No CVV field is rendered until a card number is accepted, so it could not be probed before the number fill.

Order total: #total-amount-text ('Total to be paid: AED 605'). The order.total hint resolved but reported 75 USD for an AED 605 basket, so check the amount it reads. Final button is 'Pay now' (behind a T&C checkbox) - never click it.
Arrival airport: type the city name ('Muscat') and click its option. Filling the IATA code and pressing Enter can pick the first list entry (Amsterdam) instead.
The fare cards are role=button with accessible names like 'Economy Class AED 605 Lowest price' and 'Saver Select'; text selectors miss them, role selectors work.

Contact country code (#country-code) defaults to the egress country and its list is virtualized, so another country cannot be typed or scrolled to reliably. Use a phone number in the default country's format.

2026-10-07: on two runs the proxy session was lost (connection_closed, 'This session cannot be resumed') when the 'Credit/Debit card' option on the Make a purchase page was opened. Card fields still unverified.
